rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Signal MCP provides a bridge between AI agents and Signal messaging through the signal-cli tool, enabling agents to send messages to users and groups while receiving and parsing incoming communications. Built with modern Python async patterns and comprehensive error handling, this implementation offers tools for direct messaging, group communication, and message reception with timeout support. Particularly valuable for applications requiring secure messaging integration, it allows AI systems to participate in Signal conversations while leveraging the established security features of the Signal protocol.
